open_points.subject: R0-89 restored-history loss interval
open_points.text: every change after it is lost
open_points.question: Which changes are lost: changes made after the restored backup was created, changes made after its last successful check, or some other interval?
options: Every change committed after the restored backup was created
Every change committed after the restored backup was checked
Every change committed after another recorded recovery point
open_points.default_guess: Every change committed after the restored backup was created

open_points.subject: R0-89 retention-action replay scope
open_points.text: What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship, the latest date audit entries were erased by — follows the owner's record of the retention review
open_points.question: Is this an exhaustive replay list, and does it include inverse actions such as lifting a restriction or resuming a relationship, as well as both customer erasure and project anonymisation or deletion?
options: All retention-review actions, including inverse actions and every kind of erasure
Restore the final recorded state rather than replaying individual actions
open_points.default_guess: All retention-review actions after the restored backup, including inverse actions and every kind of erasure

open_points.subject: R0-89 governance record dates
open_points.text: naming each action by its date, kind and the `customer_ref` or `project_id` it touched
open_points.question: Which date is recorded when an action has more than one relevant date, such as the execution date and an earlier relationship-end date, or the execution date and the audit-erasure cutoff?
options: Only the effective or cutoff date
Both the execution date and the effective or cutoff date
open_points.default_guess: Both the execution date and the effective or cutoff date

open_points.subject: R0-89 audit-erasure recovery record
open_points.text: the latest date audit entries were erased by ... naming each action by its date, kind and the `customer_ref` or `project_id` it touched
open_points.question: How is an audit-entry erasure represented when it touches neither a `customer_ref` nor a `project_id`, and where is its cutoff date stored?
options: A separate global governance entry with execution and cutoff dates
An entry that omits the customer/project reference
The cutoff date is stored in place of the customer/project reference
open_points.default_guess: A separate global governance entry with both execution and cutoff dates

open_points.subject: R0-89 missing recovery records
open_points.text: Where either record is missing, what the restored store holds stands until the owner corrects it.
open_points.question: Which two records does “either record” mean?
options: The migration replay materials and the retention-review record
The export file and the import choices
The retention-review record and a backup-check record
open_points.default_guess: The migration replay materials and the retention-review record
